using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Moq;
using Volo.Abp.Authorization;
using Volo.Abp.Authorization.Permissions;
using Volo.Abp.SimpleStateChecking;
using Xunit;

namespace Volo.Abp.Authorization.Tests
{
    public class RequirePermissionsSimpleStateCheckerTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task IsEnabledAsync_RequiresAll_ReturnsTrue()
        {
            // Arrange
            var serviceProvider = new ServiceCollection()
                .AddSingleton<IPermissionChecker>(Mock.Of<IPermissionChecker>(x =>
                    x.IsGrantedAsync(It.IsAny<string[]>) == Task.FromResult(new PermissionGrantResult { AllGranted = true })))
                .BuildServiceProvider();

            var context = new SimpleStateCheckerContext<object>(serviceProvider, null);
            var model = new RequirePermissionsSimpleBatchStateCheckerModel<object> { RequiresAll = true, Permissions = new[] { "Permission1" } };
            var checker = new RequirePermissionsSimpleStateChecker<object>(model);

            // Act
            var result = await checker.IsEnabledAsync(context);

            // Assert
            Assert.True(result);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task IsEnabledAsync_RequiresAll_ReturnsFalse()
        {
            // Arrange
            var serviceProvider = new ServiceCollection()
                .AddSingleton<IPermissionChecker>(Mock.Of<IPermissionChecker>(x =>
                    x.IsGrantedAsync(It.IsAny<string[]>) == Task.FromResult(new PermissionGrantResult { AllGranted = false })))
                .BuildServiceProvider();

            var context = new SimpleStateCheckerContext<object>(serviceProvider, null);
            var model = new RequirePermissionsSimpleBatchStateCheckerModel<object> { RequiresAll = true, Permissions = new[] { "Permission1" } };
            var checker = new RequirePermissionsSimpleStateChecker<object>(model);

            // Act
            var result = await checker.IsEnabledAsync(context);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task IsEnabledAsync_DoesNotRequireAll_ReturnsTrue()
        {
            // Arrange
            var serviceProvider = new ServiceCollection()
                .AddSingleton<IPermissionChecker>(Mock.Of<IPermissionChecker>(x =>
                    x.IsGrantedAsync(It.IsAny<string[]>) == Task.FromResult(new PermissionGrantResult { Result = new Dictionary<string, PermissionGrantResult> { { "Permission1", PermissionGrantResult.Granted } } })))
                .BuildServiceProvider();

            var context = new SimpleStateCheckerContext<object>(serviceProvider, null);
            var model = new RequirePermissionsSimpleBatchStateCheckerModel<object> { RequiresAll = false, Permissions = new[] { "Permission1" } };
            var checker = new RequirePermissionsSimpleStateChecker<object>(model);

            // Act
            var result = await checker.IsEnabledAsync(context);

            // Assert
            Assert.True(result);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task IsEnabledAsync_DoesNotRequireAll_ReturnsFalse()
        {
            // Arrange
            var serviceProvider = new ServiceCollection()
                .AddSingleton<IPermissionChecker>(Mock.Of<IPermissionChecker>(x =>
                    x.IsGrantedAsync(It.IsAny<string[]>) == Task.FromResult(new PermissionGrantResult { Result = new Dictionary<string, PermissionGrantResult> { { "Permission1", PermissionGrantResult.Denied } } })))
                .BuildServiceProvider();

            var context = new SimpleStateCheckerContext<object>(serviceProvider, null);
            var model = new RequirePermissionsSimpleBatchStateCheckerModel<object> { RequiresAll = false, Permissions = new[] { "Permission1" } };
            var checker = new RequirePermissionsSimpleStateChecker<object>(model);

            // Act
            var result = await checker.IsEnabledAsync(context);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
        }
    }
}
